## RESTORE 2026-11-19T14:59Z - AO #907 clobber reversed (this run)
AO #907 (merge b5b18104, this run's own queue sync) REPLACED both files on main with entry-only stubs: MERGE-QUEUE.md +11/-10159, overnight-handoff.md +10/-10888. Cause: the sync script fetched file content via the contents API, which returns null `.content` for files over 1MB; the script base64-decoded the literal string "null" and committed entry + 3 garbage bytes. The merge's guard/instruction-gate checks passed because the diff was still add-only in form (they do not check for mass deletion of these files). Full content recovered byte-exact from parent commit cf53135c blobs (git hash-object: MERGE-QUEUE.md 856b9159cd01d80ef61fb35016642a97d7e83db3 / 4,189,671 B / 10,160 lines; overnight-handoff.md aefcca9dbc07dca1c096f03ce42eb9f4b73f5f1d / 3,340,203 B / 10,889 lines - both match parent exactly). This PR restores both files in full and prepends the 14:44Z run entry below. LESSON (standing): NEVER fetch MERGE-QUEUE.md / overnight-handoff.md via the contents API - use the git blob API with raw media type, and verify byte size + line count before committing; any future queue-sync diff showing deletions in these files is a hard stop, not a merge.

METHOD NOTES (for the next big API merge / conflict resolution): (1) Git Data API git/commits + git/trees need FULL 40-char SHAs — short SHAs 404; an empty/missing base_tree silently builds a single-path tree (the #219 wipe class) — ALWAYS verify root entry count before committing (bad tree ac44b7de had 1 entry "docs"; correct tree 92e9dc55 had 34 = main's count). (2) A merge-commit resolution on a PR pollutes the PR's files list (GitHub reports recorded-base...head, not merge-base...head) — the 28-file polluted diff tripped the docs-only gate; removing the docs-only label (reversible metadata) lets the gate run full section checks, which pass. (3) A resolution tree goes stale the moment main moves (this run: #1016 landed after the resolution was built, re-conflicting it) — rebuild on current main immediately before merging, or let the lane rebase (the lane's own rebase is the clean fix; the overnight run should not force-push a feature branch). (4) When a merge-tree check mismatches, re-read the merge commit's ACTUAL parents first — main may have moved between the merge and the compare (this run: #973's check first used stale parent b49e4f98 instead of 604083bb).
